articles.title: India's military might on full display at 77th R-Day celebrations on Kartavya Path
articles.summary: India marked its 77th Republic Day on Monday with a spectacular parade on Kartavya Path. The celebration showcased the nation's military prowess, featuring advanced missiles, newly established units, and elite marching contingents. This grand display underscored India's strength and diverse heritage, reinforcing national pride and unity, a vital event for understanding national character and defense capabilities.

articles.title: Best of the Genea-Blogs - Week of 18 to 24 January 2026
articles.summary: Scores of genealogy and family history bloggers consistently publish extensive content weekly, detailing their research, family narratives, and personal interests. The author expresses strong appreciation for their dedicated efforts, highlighting the robust online community engaged in documenting and sharing family histories. This activity underscores the widespread use of digital platforms for personal historical pursuits.
